desc:
Welcome to School Incremental! A massive Incremental game with hundreds of Upgrades, dozens of Stats, multiple Prestige layers, and many Features to explore! ✨

How to play:
🤓 Buy Teachers and make Pencils!
⚡ Buy Upgrades and be Stronger!
🍀 Roll Runes and Level them up!
🔥 Prestige and unlock new content!
🏆 Reach the top and become the ultimate Teacher!

🎁 Join our Discord Channel for Codes
💎 Roblox Plus players get +10% Pencils and +10% Grades!
💖 Join the Group and Like the game for +10% Rune Speed!
